member_labels.rafter_bottom: ช่องทึบเหล็ก 125x75x8.2mm

members.description: Purlins spaced along the truss chord, running perpendicular to the rafters -- runs parallel to the eave line across the full width of the roof plan, connecting both rafter chords together at regular intervals (not individually numbered here)

Bottom-chord tie members labeled 'ตงเหล็กรูปตัวที [ ] 125x75×3.2มม.' (T-section steel purlin/member, possibly a mistranscribed shape code -- looks like a T-profile symbol rendered as '[ ]') running horizontally below the truss apex area, plus a smaller adjacent member 'แปเหล็ก [ 75x45x2.3มม Øไม่เกิน 1.00 เมตร' (C-channel purlin, max spacing 1.00m)
'อกไก่เหล็ก -125x75x2.2มม' -- flat steel cover plate ('chicken-beak' splice plate) used at the rafter splice joint near the ridge, overlapping the two rafter halves

At the lower corners of the roof plan (near grid C-D, right side), small square post symbols drawn down past the roof plane toward the ground/foundation -- likely the steel column stubs transferring the truss reaction down to the concrete eave-beam (คานอะเส ค.ส.l.) shown in the detail box above
